roadmap.rationale: Highest leverage: 18 events built almost entirely on primitives the engine already has (speed/lane/light/collision/sign/telemetry). Covers ~507 exam points (nearly half the simulatable bank) at the lowest build cost, and lights up telemetry-graded discipline (position, speed, gap, signals) that every later scenario reuses. Extends the built red-light→full-signalized, headlights-night→full lights, lane-change/mirror, and speed/stop primitives.
roadmap.effort: Low per event (reuse) — largest count but cheapest; front-loads coverage.

roadmap.phase: Phase 2 — Junctions, priority & vulnerable users (NPC actors)
roadmap.rationale: The safety core of the exam: right-of-way and collision-avoidance against live agents. Requires a reusable NPC traffic system + priority solver + pedestrian/cyclist/tram/bus/emergency actors + weather. Highest safety weight (most 'опасна' rows, incl. always-grade railway) and ~468 exam points. Build the NPC/priority framework once and 18 events fall out of it.
roadmap.effort: Medium-high — one-time NPC AI + priority-resolution + actor library; then each event is a scenario config.

roadmap.rationale: Genuinely new triggers that are still kinematic (no new vehicle physics): overhead gantry signals, dashboard telltales, in-car distraction/fatigue UI, spawnable animals, parking + Dutch-reach, police-stop actor, and post-crash scene conduct. Lower per-event coverage (~63 points) but each closes a whole topic's only drivable action (admin, fitness, accidents) and adds showcase mechanics.
roadmap.effort: Medium — new props/UI/actors, modest logic; reuses Phase-1/2 systems.

roadmap.rationale: Deferred because they need new Rapier physics (reduced-friction/aquaplane surfaces, lateral-impulse/wind, ABS/threshold pedal model) that nothing else depends on. Only ~42 points but very high safety value and strong 'feel it to learn it' payoff — worth doing once the friction/brake model exists. Fold-ins captured here: skid/aquaplane/ice + tyre-blowout/servo/crosswind (loss-of-control) and brake-straight-vs-swerve + ABS technique (emergency-braking).
roadmap.effort: High per event — bespoke physics; low count, do last.

events.name: Изпреварване (overtaking)
events.trigger: Slower vehicle ahead in a zone where overtaking may or may not be legal (solid line, crest, junction, bridge, no-overtaking sign, night). Also covers being overtaken (facilitate the pass).
events.detection: Does ego cross to the opposing/adjacent lane to pass; is the line solid, is oncoming clear, is sight distance adequate; as overtaken vehicle, does ego avoid accelerating and keep right.
events.success: Overtake only with a broken/absent centre line, clear oncoming and full sight distance, then return right; when being overtaken, hold speed and keep right (ЗДвП чл. 41–43).
events.failure: Passing over a solid line, at a crest/junction/bridge/pedestrian crossing, into occupied oncoming lane, or accelerating while being overtaken.
events.feedback: Изпреварвай само при чиста насрещна, прекъсната линия и видимост — при знак, мост, завой или кръстовище не се изпреварва.

events.name: Скорост, съобразена с условията
events.trigger: Reduced-grip/visibility context: fog, night/low-beam range, sharp bend, icy bridge, rain, steep descent, pedestrian-dense area.
events.detection: Ego speed vs a condition-derived safe speed (stopping distance within visible/clear road).
events.success: Slow below the posted cap so you can stop within the visible clear distance (ЗДвП чл. 20).
events.failure: Holding the sign/limit speed when fog, wet, night or a bend demand slower.
events.feedback: Знакът е таван за идеални условия — в мъгла, дъжд, нощ и завой карай осезаемо по-бавно.

events.name: Забранена зона за спиране/паркиране
events.trigger: Ego attempts to stop/stand where prohibited: crossing, junction, bus/tram stop, bike lane, hatched area, disabled bay, garage entry, narrow street, motorway lane, under V27/V28 sign.
events.detection: Ego reaches v=0 within a prohibited-stop zone tag.
events.success: Do not stop in the tagged zone, even briefly for boarding (ЗДвП чл. 93–98).
events.failure: Coming to rest inside the prohibited zone.
events.feedback: Тук не спираш — на пешеходна, кръстовище, спирка, велоалея, защрихована площ или под знака за забрана.

events.name: Обезопасяване при принудително спиране
events.trigger: Breakdown/forced stop on the carriageway or hard shoulder (in-town, rural, motorway, night).
events.detection: Hazard lights on (in-cab, gradeable); vest-before-exit and triangle-at-distance are procedural checklist steps outside the cockpit.
events.success: Hazard lights immediately, vest before leaving the car, triangle 30 m (100 m motorway) behind, wait behind the barrier, call 112 (ЗДвП чл. 97, чл. 101).
events.failure: Only opening the bonnet, staying in-lane, exiting without a vest, or no triangle.
events.feedback: Аварийни светлини + жилетка преди да слезеш + триъгълник зад колата — така те виждат отдалеч.

events.name: Светофарно кръстовище
events.trigger: Signalized junction: green/amber-dilemma/red, red+amber, flashing/blinking green, directional-arrow main signal, additional-section arrow, two-section, snow-covered vertical head; plus box-junction gridlock on green.
events.detection: Stop position vs stop-line/phase; does ego run red or a non-matching arrow; on green, does ego enter a junction it cannot clear (box-block).
events.success: Stop on steady amber/red before the line; go on green only if the exit is clear; obey arrow direction; don't block the junction (ППЗДвП чл. 31; ЗДвП чл. 47).
events.failure: Accelerating to beat red, entering on a dark/red arrow, or stopping inside a gridlocked junction.
events.feedback: Червено/жълто спира, зелено пуска при чист изход; стрелката отваря само своята посока, а на зелено не влизаш в задръстено кръстовище.

events.name: Използване на светлините
events.trigger: Contexts requiring a light decision: daytime DRL/low-beam, dusk, tunnel, fog (front/rear fog lamps), oncoming at night (high-beam dip).
events.detection: Light state (DRL/low/high/fog front/fog rear) vs ambient/visibility context.
events.success: DRL or low beam day and night; low beam at dusk/tunnel/fog; dip high beam for oncoming in time; fog lamps only <50 m visibility (ЗДвП чл. 70, 74, 75).
events.failure: Driving dark at dusk/night, keeping high beam on oncoming, or fog lamps on a clear road (dazzle).
events.feedback: Къси/дневни денонощно; на здрач, тунел и мъгла — къси; насрещен нощем — превключи от дълги навреме.
events.legalNote: Предни фарове за мъгла — при значително намалена видимост, заедно с къси светлини. Заден червен фар за мъгла — само под 50 м видимост и изключен, ако заслепява.

events.name: Кръстовище със знак за предимство
events.trigger: Junction governed by Б1 give-way / priority-road sign / shark-teeth marking / dead traffic light handing control to the sign.
events.detection: Does ego yield to priority-road traffic (stop only if needed for Б1); holder-of-priority keeps watching side roads.
events.success: Give way to traffic on the priority road; with a dead light, the signs below it govern (ЗДвП чл. 7, чл. 50).
events.failure: Entering ahead of priority traffic or misapplying the right-hand rule.
events.feedback: Б1/акулски зъби значи пропусни предимството; изгасне ли светофарът, оживяват знаците под него.

events.name: Спазване на скоростното ограничение
events.trigger: Posted max-speed sign, general urban/rural/motorway limit, zone-30, conditional plate ('when wet'), end-of-limit, or blue minimum-speed sign.
events.detection: Ego speed vs the active limit (accounting for sign scope ending at junctions/end signs) — including too-slow vs a minimum-speed sign.
events.success: Keep within the active max (50 urban / 90 open / 140 motorway or posted); don't crawl below a posted minimum (ЗДвП чл. 21).
events.failure: Exceeding the active cap, or going under a mandatory minimum without cause.
events.feedback: Спазвай тавана на знака до кръстовище/край; в града 50, магистрала 140, а синият кръг е минимум.

events.name: Дистанция на следване
events.trigger: Ego follows a lead vehicle; gap closes below a safe time-headway.
events.detection: Time/space gap to the lead vehicle vs a 2-second (doubled when wet/icy) threshold.
events.success: Keep at least a 2-second gap, doubled in rain/ice (ЗДвП чл. 23–24).
events.failure: Tailgating within an unsafe headway that cannot absorb a sudden brake.
events.feedback: Дръж поне 2 секунди дистанция — на мокро и лед удвои; който залепва, не може да спре навреме.

events.name: Отбранително и икономично шофиране
events.trigger: Continuous telemetry over smoothness (throttle/brake/steering), anticipation, engine-braking on descents, and cover-brake when another user may violate your right-of-way.
events.detection: Harsh/late braking and jerky inputs; on a descent, coasting/neutral or riding the brake (fade); at a green/priority approach with a possible conflict, whether ego eases off and covers the brake.
events.success: Drive smoothly and read ahead; on grades use engine braking; even with priority, reduce speed and cover the brake before a developing conflict (ЗДвП чл. 20).
events.failure: Harsh late braking, neutral/brake-riding descent, or blind reliance on right-of-way into a conflict.
events.feedback: Карай плавно и предвиждай — дори с предимство свали крак от газта и покрий спирачката, когато друг може да сгреши.

events.name: Смяна на лента / престрояване
events.trigger: Lateral maneuver: lane change, pulling out from parking, pre-turn lane positioning, turn beside a bike lane, with a vehicle possibly in the blind spot.
events.detection: Mirror check + shoulder glance to the blind spot + indicator before the maneuver; does ego force in or take the wrong lane.
events.success: Mirror + shoulder check + signal, yield to traffic already in the lane, position early for turns (ЗДвП чл. 25).
events.failure: Changing on mirror only, no shoulder check, forcing in, or a last-moment lane grab.
events.feedback: Огледало + поглед през рамо в мъртвата зона + мигач, и чак тогава плавно се престрой; сигналът не купува предимство.

events.name: Пешеходец на пешеходна пътека
events.trigger: Marked crossing (zebra/signalized) with a pedestrian on or approaching it, including turn-across-pedestrian and stroller/elderly/blind variants.
events.detection: Does ego yield/stop for a pedestrian on the crossing; does it stop before the stop-line.
events.success: Slow early and give way to pedestrians on/entering the crossing; yield when turning across a crossing (ЗДвП чл. 119).
events.failure: Failing to yield, blocking the crossing, or passing a car stopped at the crossing.
events.feedback: Пешеходец на пътеката има предимство — намали отрано и спри, особено при завой през пътеката.

events.name: Възстановяване при загуба на контрол
events.trigger: Dynamic upset: rear/front skid, aquaplaning, ice, or a sudden disturbance (blown tyre, lost power steering, crosswind gust on a bridge/tunnel exit).
events.detection: Throttle release, steady/countersteer wheel input, absence of abrupt braking/steering, smooth pull-over when required.
events.success: Ease off the throttle, hold/steer gently toward your path, no hard braking; on a blown tyre hold firm and pull over smoothly (ЗДвП чл. 20).
events.failure: Hard braking, sharp steering, yanking the handbrake, or overcorrecting into a spin.
events.feedback: Загубиш ли сцепление или контрол — крак от газта, здраво и меко волан, без рязка спирачка; при спукана гума отбий плавно.

events.name: Ляв завой — пропускане на насрещните
events.trigger: Ego turns left across an oncoming stream (and any pedestrians on the entered arm).
events.detection: Does ego wait for a safe gap in oncoming traffic and yield to pedestrians before completing the turn.
events.success: Give way to oncoming traffic and to pedestrians crossing the road you enter (ЗДвП чл. 37).
events.failure: Cutting across the oncoming stream or into pedestrians.
events.feedback: Преди ляв завой пропусни насрещните и пешеходците — ти пресичаш техния път.

events.name: Шофиране при тежки условия
events.trigger: Rain, snow, fog or reduced-grip surface compound conditions across a stretch.
events.detection: Combined speed, following distance, light choice and input smoothness vs the weather state.
events.success: Reduce speed, extend distance, use correct lights and smooth inputs for the weather (ЗДвП чл. 20).
events.failure: Normal speed/gap or wrong lights in rain/snow/fog.
events.feedback: В дъжд, сняг и мъгла — по-бавно, повече дистанция, съответните светлини и плавни движения.

events.name: Включване в движението
events.trigger: Ego joins a traffic stream: from a side road/driveway/parking/residential zone onto a road with moving traffic.
events.detection: Does ego yield to all traffic on the road before entering.
events.success: Give way to everyone already on the road when joining (ЗДвП чл. 25).
events.failure: Pulling out ahead of moving traffic and forcing it to brake.
events.feedback: Включваш ли се в движение (от отбивка, паркинг, жилищна зона) — пропусни всички по платното.

events.name: Равнозначно кръстовище (правило на дясното)
events.trigger: Unsignalized, unsigned equal junction (or a flashing-yellow/dead light that makes it equal) with a vehicle approaching from the right.
events.detection: Does ego yield to the vehicle coming from the right.
events.success: Give way to traffic from your right at an equal junction (ЗДвП чл. 50).
events.failure: Entering ahead of the vehicle on the right / relying on speed or 'first in'.
events.feedback: Равнозначно кръстовище — пропусни идващия отдясно.

events.name: Реакция на пътна маркировка и указателни знаци
events.trigger: Road markings and prescribed-direction signs: solid/broken/double lines, lane arrows, stop-line, hatched (forbidden) area, edge line, temporary orange marking, and mandatory blue-arrow direction signs.
events.detection: Wheel position vs markings; does ego cross a solid line, enter hatching, or drive against the prescribed lane-arrow/mandatory-sign direction; stop before the stop-line.
events.success: Obey the prescribed direction, don't cross solid lines or enter hatched zones, follow temporary orange over permanent (Наредба № 2/2001; ЗДвП чл. 6, чл. 7).
events.failure: Crossing a solid line, driving into hatching, or going against the lane arrow/mandatory sign.
events.feedback: Следвай маркировката, стрелките и сините заповедни знаци; непрекъсната линия не се пресича, защрихованата площ не се застъпва.

events.name: Сигнали на регулировчик
events.trigger: Officer directing traffic at a junction (possibly overriding a live/green light), with readable body poses and orientation.
events.detection: Does ego obey the controller's pose (raised arm / chest-or-back facing = stop; side-on with arms out = go) over the light/signs; clear the junction if already inside.
events.success: The controller ranks above lights and signs — stop for a raised arm or when facing his chest/back; proceed when side-on (ЗДвП чл. 7; ППЗДвП чл. 66).
events.failure: Going on green against a stop pose, or stopping/reversing inside the junction on a raised arm.
events.feedback: Регулировчикът е над светофара и знаците — вдигната ръка или гръб/гърди значат спри.

events.name: Взаимодействие с велосипедист
events.trigger: Cyclist ahead/alongside: overtaking a bike, right-hook on a right turn, bike lane crossing, cyclist hand-signal.
events.detection: Lateral clearance when passing (≥1.5 m); does ego cut across a cyclist when turning right or crossing a bike lane.
events.success: Pass with ≥1.5 m clearance and don't right-hook the cyclist; give way across bike lanes (ЗДвП чл. 40, чл. 42).
events.failure: Passing too close or turning right/across into the cyclist.
events.feedback: Изпреварвай велосипедиста с поне 1,5 м и не го засичай при десен завой; пази велоалеята.
events.lawRef: ЗДвП чл. 42 (достатъчно странично разстояние); чл. 25 и чл. 37 при завиване/пресичане на велоалея
events.legalNote: Законът иска „достатъчно странично разстояние“ (чл. 42) — 1.5 м е препоръка за безопасност, не норма. Без чл. 40 (то е за движение назад).

events.name: Разминаване с насрещно движение
events.trigger: Road too narrow for two: obstacle on your half, signed narrowing (Б5/Б6), single-track or mountain grade, narrow bridge.
events.detection: Does ego wait for the oncoming vehicle to clear the pinch when the obstacle is on ego's side / it lacks priority; uphill vehicle keeps priority.
events.success: Yield and wait when the obstacle is on your half or the sign gives the oncoming priority; uphill has priority on grades (ЗДвП чл. 44, чл. 46).
events.failure: Forcing into the pinch against a priority oncoming vehicle (head-on risk).
events.feedback: При тясно, мост или препятствие на твоята страна — изчакай и пропусни насрещния; нагоре по баир предимство има изкачващият.

events.name: Паркиране и обезопасяване
events.trigger: Parking task: parallel/perpendicular positioning, per-plate orientation, slope securing, and safe exit (door opening).
events.detection: Rightmost/parallel position, wheel-angle + handbrake + gear on a slope, and mirror/shoulder check ('Dutch reach') before opening the door.
events.success: Park rightmost and parallel; on a slope turn the wheels and set the handbrake; check before opening the door into the carriageway (ЗДвП чл. 94, чл. 95).
events.failure: Sloppy positioning, no slope-securing, or dooring a passing cyclist without a check.
events.feedback: Паркирай вдясно и плътно; на наклон завий колелата и вдигни ръчна, и отваряй вратата с оглед назад.

events.name: Обратен завой и заден ход (забрани)
events.trigger: Attempted U-turn or reversing where prohibited: motorway/expressway, tunnel, junction, across a central reservation, one-way street.
events.detection: Does ego perform a U-turn/reverse in a prohibited location (wrong-way exposure).
events.success: No U-turn or reversing on motorways, in tunnels, at junctions or across the median — drive to a permitted spot (ЗДвП чл. 38, чл. 40).
events.failure: U-turn/reverse in a banned location = driving against traffic.
events.feedback: Без обратен завой и заден ход на магистрала, в тунел, на кръстовище и през разделителна ивица — това е движение срещу трафика.
events.lawRef: ЗДвП чл. 38 (забрана за обратен завой на определени места); чл. 40 (движение назад)
events.legalNote: Обратен завой на кръстовище по принцип е разрешен; чл. 38 забранява само на конкретни места (лоша видимост, пешеходна пътека, жп прелез, мост/тунел/надлез, при знак). Движение назад през кръстовище е забранено (чл. 40).

events.name: Пешеходна опасност без пътека
events.trigger: Pedestrian hazard off a marked crossing: ball-then-child, jaywalker, wheelchair, child column/procession, someone emerging between parked cars, alighting bus passengers.
events.detection: Does ego slow/brake and be ready to stop for the emerging pedestrian(s).
events.success: Anticipate and slow, ready to stop, for pedestrians entering the road without a crossing; treat a marshalled column as one body (ЗДвП чл. 20, чл. 116, чл. 122).
events.failure: Maintaining speed and striking/near-missing the pedestrian, or cutting through a column.
events.feedback: Дете, топка, слизащ от автобус или спрели коли — намали и бъди готов да спреш, дори без пътека.

events.name: Пропускане на автомобил със специален режим
events.trigger: Emergency vehicle with beacon + siren approaches (from behind or crossing), including while ego has green.
events.detection: Does ego pull to the right smoothly and give way (not accelerate, not tailgate it).
events.success: Give unobstructed passage — pull right and, if needed, stop, even on your green (ЗДвП чл. 91–92).
events.failure: Holding speed on green, blocking it, or tailgating the emergency vehicle to slip through.
events.feedback: Чуеш ли сирена и видиш буркан — отбий вдясно и спри; зеленото не е щит срещу линейката.

events.name: Навлизане/движение по магистрала
events.trigger: Motorway/expressway on-ramp merge, lane use, hard-shoulder misuse, exit; min/max speed context.
events.detection: Ramp acceleration and merge yielding; illegal hard-shoulder driving/stopping; speed within band.
events.success: Accelerate on the ramp to traffic speed and merge; use the hard shoulder only for breakdowns; keep within the speed band (ЗДвП чл. 21, чл. 55 и сл.).
events.failure: Merging too slow/forcing in, driving/resting in the hard shoulder, or exceeding 140.
events.feedback: Ускори по рампата до скоростта на потока и се влей; аварийната лента е само за повреда, не за почивка/изпреварване.

events.name: Кръгово кръстовище
events.trigger: Roundabout entry with circulating traffic and the mandatory direction sign.
events.detection: Does ego give way to traffic already circulating and travel the correct direction/lane.
events.success: Yield to vehicles in the roundabout and circulate in the signed direction; the sign shows direction, not priority (ЗДвП чл. 50, ал. 1 + Наредба № РД-02-21-1/23.11.2023 чл. 61, ал. 5).
events.failure: Forcing entry ahead of circulating traffic or going the wrong way.
events.feedback: На кръговото пропусни движещите се в него и обикаляй в правилната посока; знакът показва посока, не предимство.
events.legalNote: Кръговото: в ЗДвП НЯМА член за предимство на кръгово. Знакът Б3 „Път с предимство“ не може да се поставя на входовете на кръгово кръстовище (Наредба № РД-02-21-1/23.11.2023, чл. 61, ал. 5), затова там стои Б1 или Б2 и влизащият пропуска движещите се в кръга по чл. 50, ал. 1 ЗДвП. Знакът Г12 дава само посоката (същата наредба, чл. 98, ал. 1). (Поправено 2026-08-03 от погрешно чл. 50а — това е правилото за блокирано кръстовище.)

events.name: Пропускане на потеглящ автобус
events.trigger: In a built-up area, a bus signals and pulls out of a marked stop.
events.detection: Does ego let the indicating bus rejoin traffic.
events.success: Give way to a public-transport bus leaving a stop in town when it has signalled (ЗДвП чл. 100).
events.failure: Overtaking/blocking the bus as it pulls out.
events.feedback: В населено място пропусни автобус, който напуска спирка и е подал мигач.
events.legalNote: В населено място намали/спри, за да пуснеш автобус от редовна линия да потегли от обозначена спирка (чл. 67). (Поправено от чл. 100 — то е за документите.)

events.name: Железопътен прелез
events.trigger: Approaching a level crossing: barriers up/down/lowering, flashing red, Б2 stop, or dark signals.
events.detection: Does ego slow, stop for a lowered/lowering barrier, flashing red or Б2, and check both ways before crossing.
events.success: Stop for a barrier, flashing red or Б2; with dark signals cross only after checking both ways — the train can't stop for you (ЗДвП чл. 51).
events.failure: Crossing on flashing red / a lowering barrier or without stopping at Б2.
events.feedback: Пред прелез намали; при спуснат бариер, мигаща червена или Б2 спираш винаги — влакът не може да спре за теб.

events.name: Знак Б2 „Спри!“
events.trigger: Junction with a Б2 STOP sign, with or without a marked stop-line, possibly with occluded sight lines.
events.detection: Full stop (v=0) at the line/edge of the crossing road; creep-and-stop again where sight is blocked.
events.success: Come to a full stop every time, then proceed only when clear; where blind, stop-creep-stop (ЗДвП чл. 50).
events.failure: Rolling through without a full stop, or entering blind.
events.feedback: Б2 значи пълно спиране винаги — колелата спират на линията, после потегляш, щом е чисто.

events.name: Дисциплина на движение вдясно
events.trigger: Continuous position on a two-way road / one-way / near a hard shoulder or verge.
events.detection: Lateral position: does ego keep to the right half and as far right as safe; does it drive on the verge/hard shoulder.
events.success: Keep right, as far right as practical; the verge and hard shoulder aren't for driving (ЗДвП чл. 8, чл. 15).
events.failure: Drifting to the centre/left without cause, or driving on the verge/shoulder to jump a queue.
events.feedback: Дръж се вдясно, възможно най-вдясно; банкетът и аварийната лента не са за движение.

events.name: Взаимодействие с трамвай
events.trigger: Tram present: crossing tram rails, tram pulling off with equal priority, or passengers at a tram stop.
events.detection: Does ego avoid cutting in front of an approaching tram and yield when it has priority; protect the tram stop.
events.success: Don't cross in front of an approaching tram; give way when it departs equal-priority; protect boarding passengers (ЗДвП чл. 50, чл. 66).
events.failure: Cutting across the rails ahead of a tram or ignoring stop passengers.
events.feedback: Не пресичай пред приближаващ трамвай и му дай предимство, когато тръгва едновременно с теб; пази спирката.

events.name: Реакция на предупредителен знак (група А)
events.trigger: Warning sign ahead: children, slippery road, uneven surface, sharp bend, animals, etc.
events.detection: Does ego reduce speed and prepare (cover brake) before the hazard, without an unnecessary full stop.
events.success: Slow and be ready to react before the warned hazard (ЗДвП чл. 20).
events.failure: Keeping/raising speed, or panic-stopping needlessly.
events.feedback: Предупредителният знак иска готовност — намали и покрий спирачката преди опасността, без излишно пълно спиране.

events.name: Режим на зона (жилищна/училищна)
events.trigger: Entering a residential or school zone (holds from the entry sign to the end sign, across internal junctions).
events.detection: Speed ≤20/30 cap, full-width pedestrian priority, and (residential) parking only at marked bays — sustained until the end sign.
events.success: Keep the walking-pace cap, give pedestrians priority across the whole street, park only at marked spots (ЗДвП чл. 116).
events.failure: Speeding up after an internal junction, failing to yield to pedestrians, or parking off-bay.
events.feedback: В жилищна/училищна зона — до 20–30 км/ч, пешеходците са с предимство по цялата улица, готов да спреш.
events.legalNote: Жилищна зона: таван 20 км/ч, предимство на пешеходци по цялата ширина, паркиране само на обозначени места (чл. 61–62). Не чл. 116 (обща грижа).

events.name: Забранителен знак — не навлизай/срещу посока
events.trigger: No-entry / one-way against direction / pedestrian-zone entry sign at a street mouth.
events.detection: Does ego enter the prohibited/wrong-way street or a pedestrian zone.
events.success: Do not enter — wrong-way entry means driving into oncoming traffic (ЗДвП чл. 6, чл. 15).
events.failure: Entering against the no-entry/one-way/pedestrian-zone sign.
events.feedback: Знакът за забранено влизане/еднопосочна/пешеходна зона значи не навлизаш — иначе караш срещу трафика.

events.name: Поведение на местопроизшествие
events.trigger: Ego's vehicle collides with something (parked car, barrier, pedestrian) in-sim.
events.detection: Does ego stop and remain at the scene (vs driving off); does it avoid disturbing the scene; move the car only for property-only damage.
events.success: Stop and stay, secure the scene, don't flee or disturb it, don't drink; move the car only if damage is purely material (ЗДвП чл. 123).
events.failure: Leaving the scene (hit-and-run) or moving the car with an injured party.
events.feedback: След удар спри и остани на място — не бягай, не размествай и не пий алкохол; мести колата само при чисто материални щети.

events.name: Дисциплина на сигнализиране (мигач/клаксон)
events.trigger: Any maneuver requiring an indicator, and horn/headlight-flash use contexts.
events.detection: Indicator timing (before the maneuver, cancelled after); horn used only to prevent an accident (not as a greeting in town).
events.success: Signal before and cancel after the maneuver; in town the horn is only to prevent a crash (ЗДвП чл. 25, чл. 71).
events.failure: Signalling only when cars are near, leaving it on, or horn as a greeting.
events.feedback: Сигнализирай преди маневрата и изключи след нея; клаксон в града — само срещу произшествие, не за поздрав.

events.name: Аварийно спиране (техника и решение)
events.trigger: Sudden in-lane hazard (child, animal, fallen object) demanding a hard stop; a swerve path may lead into oncoming/occupied lane.
events.detection: Pedal force/hold (ABS full-and-hold vs threshold without ABS), retained steering, brake-straight vs unsafe swerve, contact avoidance.
events.success: Brake hard and straight — with ABS press full and hold, without ABS modulate; change lane only if clearly safe (ЗДвП чл. 20).
events.failure: Pumping/easing an ABS stop, locking without ABS, or swerving into greater danger.
events.feedback: Опасност отпред — спирай силно и право; с ABS натисни докрай и задръж, без ABS спирай дозирано, не завивай в насрещното.

events.name: Разсейване и годност на водача
events.trigger: Secondary-task or impairment context while moving: phone in hand, dialling nav, headphones, eating, or mounting fatigue on a long/monotonous stretch.
events.detection: Does the driver handle the phone/secondary device while v>0 (vs hands-free); under a fatigue overlay, does the driver stop to rest rather than push on.
events.success: Use only hands-free and set nav before departure; when fatigued, stop at a safe place to rest (ЗДвП чл. 5, чл. 104а).
events.failure: Holding/operating the phone while moving, or driving on through clear fatigue signals.
events.feedback: Остави телефона и вторичните задачи — в движение само „свободни ръце“; усетиш ли умора, спри и си почини, не карай на воля.

events.name: Реакция на контролна лампа
events.trigger: A dashboard telltale lights while driving: oil pressure, battery/charging, temperature, brake system.
events.detection: Colour-appropriate response — red = pull over and stop the engine now; amber = caution, drive to a garage; brake-warning + soft pedal = stop safely, don't continue.
events.success: Red telltale: stop and switch off immediately; amber: reach a garage; a soft brake pedal with the brake light means stop, don't drive on (ЗДвП чл. 20, чл. 139).
events.failure: Driving on with a red light, opening a hot radiator cap, or continuing with failing brakes.
events.feedback: Червена лампа значи спри веднага и угаси; жълта — внимание и до сервиз; не отваряй горещата капачка на радиатора.

events.name: Животно на пътното платно
events.trigger: Wildlife/livestock enters the carriageway: an animal darting out, or a herd blocking the road (rural/dusk/night).
events.detection: Straight-line emergency braking without swerving into oncoming/ditch for a darting animal; slowing to walking pace, no horn/weaving for a herd.
events.success: Brake straight for a darting animal — don't swerve into oncoming; for a herd slow to walking pace, no horn (ЗДвП чл. 20).
events.failure: Swerving into the opposite lane/ditch, or ploughing/honking through a herd.
events.feedback: Животно на пътя — спирай право и силно, без да завиваш в насрещното или канавката; при стадо намали до ход, без клаксон.

events.name: Надлентови сигнали (гантри X/стрелка)
events.trigger: Overhead per-lane gantry signals in a tunnel/motorway: red X (lane closed), green down-arrow (open), diagonal flashing-yellow (vacate lane).
events.detection: Does ego read the signal above its own lane and change out of a red-X lane in time and safely.
events.success: Vacate a lane under a red X into the lane with the green arrow, in good time (ППЗДвП чл. 33).
events.failure: Staying in / stopping under a red-X lane, or misreading a signal as applying to all lanes.
events.feedback: Червен X над лентата я затваря — престрой се навреме към лентата със зелената стрелка.

events.name: Спиране по сигнал на полиция
events.trigger: An officer signals ego to stop: day stop-paddle, night red semicircle light, or an unmarked car's 'Полиция' sign.
events.detection: Does ego decelerate smoothly and pull over to the right at the indicated spot (vs stopping abruptly in-lane or ignoring the signal).
events.success: Decelerate smoothly and pull over to the right where indicated (ЗДвП чл. 103).
events.failure: Ignoring the signal, or braking hard and stopping in the lane.
events.feedback: Дадат ли ти сигнал за спиране (палка, червен диск, надпис „Полиция“) — намали плавно и отбий вдясно на посоченото място.

events.name: Предпазен колан
events.trigger: Setting off and driving, with passengers present.
events.detection: Driver belt fastened before/while moving; don't set off with visibly unbelted passengers (incl. rear seats).
events.success: Belt on before setting off, always, at any speed, for driver and passengers including the rear (ЗДвП чл. 137а).
events.failure: Setting off/driving unbelted or with unbelted passengers.
events.feedback: Колан преди потегляне — винаги, на всяка скорост, и за пътниците, включително отзад.

events.name: Сблъсък (крайно събитие)
events.trigger: Global outcome detector: ego contacts any object, pedestrian or vehicle; also illustrates definitional impacts (reverse scratch, animal strike).
events.detection: Contact event registered; used as the universal fail-state that escalates any active event to опасна.
events.success: No contact — every other event exists to prevent this outcome.
events.failure: Any collision.
events.feedback: Ударът е крайната грешка — всяко закъсняло спиране или засичане тук завършва с щета; карай така, че да го избегнеш.
